title: refactor: the test-only replay helper leaves the runtime and two copies of the cache helper fold into evidence._cached
why: cli/wuwei is at 2,996 of 3,000 lines on main 8ea4192, so draft-raise (the fix for bug #1074) cannot land; a probe of these four edits frees 34 lines with the suite green.
promise: Free 34 runtime lines with no change in behaviour, so draft-raise fits under the 3,000-line budget (tests/test_setup.py::test_the_runtime_holds_its_size_budget). Where the lines come from, measured on main 8ea4192 (2,996 lines): (1) replay.replay(directory, scratch, monkeypatch), cli/wuwei/replay.py lines 42-59, has no runtime caller: only tests/test_replay.py calls it, and it takes pytest's monkeypatch. It moves into tests/test_replay.py as a module helper, and the now unused import datetime (replay.py line 4) goes: 19 lines. replay.record and wuwei evidence --record stay as they are. (2) board._list (board.py lines 10-12) repeats evidence._cached (evidence.py lines 128-130) with max_age=TTL. Its one caller (board.py line 69) calls evidence._cached(root, f'prs-{key}', lambda: gh.open_prs(repo), TTL): 5 lines. (3) evidence.items_named (evidence.py lines 93-94) has one caller (board.py line 55), which reads evidence.ITEM.findall(pr.get('body') or '') in place: 4 lines. (4) guards._default (guards.py lines 106-116) repeats the get-or-put cache read. It becomes a 5-line function through evidence._cached with the same cache name, the same 86400 s age, {'main', 'master'} with no repository and on gh.GhError, and nothing cached on an error: 6 lines. The runtime drops to 2,962 lines. Touches cli/wuwei/replay.py, cli/wuwei/board.py, cli/wuwei/evidence.py, cli/wuwei/guards.py (only _default), tests/test_replay.py, and the vendored copy under .claude/wuwei/cli/wuwei/ by re-vendoring. Starts before draft-raise, which edits other parts of guards.py. Rollback: revert the commit; no data, config or CLI changes. Outside: any CLI flag or output, the replay case format, the guards' routes. Assumption: tier full because guards.py is the door code, as for free-lines; the diff should pick fewer gates. Overturned if the owner rates a behaviour-neutral change in guards.py as standard. Alternative recorded, not chosen: moving all of replay.py and the --record flag into scripts/ frees 65 lines, but it removes a documented CLI flag (docs/site/reference.md line 20, README.md line 96), which is a breaking: question for the owner.
acceptance: given the change, when the suite runs, then the runtime under cli/wuwei is 2,962 lines or fewer and every test passes, the vendored-drift test included after re-vendoring

given the recorded case under tests/replay/standard-pr-with-owner-paths, when tests/test_replay.py runs with the helper in the test module, then the case gives the gaps it recorded and record-then-replay round trips
given the change, when cli/wuwei is searched, then no module defines replay(, _list( or items_named(, and wuwei evidence --record DIR still writes DIR/case.json

given a repository whose default-branch lookup raises GhError, when git push origin main is read, then it is refused as on main, and given a cached default branch trunk, when git push origin trunk is read, then it is refused with no gh call
given a PR body naming WUWEI-Item: X-1 and WUWEI-Item: X-2, when the board computes, then both items link the PR as on main

title: fix(guards): a draft PR opens before its gates, and the flip to ready waits for them
why: Bug #1074, which the owner opened on 2026-10-16: the create door refuses gh pr create --draft, which departs from the owner's #1050 ruling and blocks every repository whose CI runs only on PRs.
promise: The raise follows the owner's #1050 ruling, which the owner restated in #1074: open as draft, gate at the draft head after CI, then flip to ready. Create door: a draft passes before its gates. That covers gh pr create or gh pr new with --draft or -d, gh api POST repos/<r>/pulls with draft=true (from -f, -F or a --input JSON "draft": true), and MCP create_pull_request with draft true. A non-draft create stays held as today, and its refusal tells the seat to open a draft. Ready door: the flip to ready is held until the gates the diff needs pass at the PR head. That covers gh pr ready (not --undo), gh api POST repos/<r>/pulls/<n>/ccr/ready_for_review and MCP update_pull_request with draft false. A reviewer request on a draft PR is held the same way: gh pr edit --add-reviewer, gh api POST .../pulls/<n>/requested_reviewers, and MCP update_pull_request with reviewers. The ready door reads the PR once (gh.pr) and reuses create_door on its head, base and body, so it adds no new gate logic. markPullRequestReadyForReview joins the refused gh api graphql mutations, with a pointer to gh pr ready or the CCR route. update_pull_request joins guards.DOORS, so the fail-closed check (#1095) covers it. Review pings need no code: evidence.review_duty already skips drafts (evidence.py line 86). Charters and docs state the order: charters/_way.md (the gates line and the refusals line), charters/builder.md (push, then open a draft), charters/shepherd.md (Raise 1-3: draft first, ready and reviewers after the gates), docs/design.md (the gates row) and docs/site/concepts/doors.md. Touches cli/wuwei/guards.py, its vendored copy, tests/test_guards.py, tests/fixtures/routes.json, those charters, agents/*.md (built) and those docs. Lines: estimate +25 runtime. It starts after free-lines-2 (2,996 on main 8ea4192, 2,962 after). Smaller than the approved version: doors-by-rest has merged (#1096), so the REST create route and the route table already exist; pings are dropped because they are already true; the gate check is reused. Outside: review pings posted to a channel, a wuwei/gates commit status (#918), green CI as a condition for ready (CI already holds the merge), reviewer requests on a non-draft PR, and marking verdicts written after the merge (#1050 ask 2). Assumption: the ruling stands; the owner restated it in #1074 on 2026-10-16. Overturned if the owner prefers gates before the PR. Assumption: the GitHub MCP update_pull_request tool carries draft and reviewers. Overturned if the server names a separate reviewer tool; that tool then joins the same check.
acceptance: given a pushed branch with no gates, when "gh pr create --draft -t t -F body.md" is read, then it passes (with the PR standard note once); without --draft it is refused and the reason names gh pr create --draft
given a pushed branch with no gates, when "gh api -X POST repos/o/r/pulls -f head=b -f base=main -F draft=true" is read, then it passes; without draft=true it is refused as today
given an MCP create_pull_request with draft true and no gates, when PreToolUse runs, then it passes; with draft false or absent it is refused as today

given draft PR 7 with gates missing at its head, when "gh pr ready 7", "gh api -X POST repos/o/r/pulls/7/ccr/ready_for_review" or MCP update_pull_request with pullNumber 7 and draft false is read, then it is refused naming the missing gates; "gh pr ready 7 --undo" passes
given draft PR 7 with every needed gate passed at its head, when "gh pr ready 7" is read, then it passes

given draft PR 7 with gates missing, when "gh pr edit 7 --add-reviewer bob" or "gh api -X POST repos/o/r/pulls/7/requested_reviewers -f reviewers[]=bob" is read, then it is refused; for a non-draft PR it passes
given "gh api graphql -f query='mutation{markPullRequestReadyForReview(input:{pullRequestId:\"x\"}){clientMutationId}}'", when it is read, then it is refused with the pointer to gh pr ready
given the change, when the suite runs, then the runtime is 3,000 lines or fewer, the agents match the charters and the vendored copy matches the tree
